caption: The drawing depicts the detailed front view of a doorway set into a vertical wall with horizontal siding lines. The central object is a rectangular door with four panels, two smaller ones at the top and two larger ones at the bottom. The door is flanked on each side by vertical sidelights, each consisting of eight small panes of glass arranged in two columns and four rows. Surrounding the door and sidelights is an ornate frame with moldings, including pilasters on either side that extend upward to a horizontal transom window positioned above the door, which contains ten rectangular panes. The transom window sits just below an overhanging cornice marked by detailed trim work. Beneath the door is a rectangular stoop or step, with grass and rough ground indicated in the foreground. The color scheme is monochromatic, executed in black or dark brown ink on light beige or off-white paper, characterized by precise line work and cross-hatching for shading and texture. There are technical notes beneath the image, such as the scale, written in small script.
title: Doorway
